name: Enara – LMS: connection check failed
trigger: New code needed: 'Check connection' (on save, on demand, daily) plus a daily scan of lms_audit_log fail codes per platform
frequency: Immediate after a check that changed from OK to failed; from the scan max once per platform+cause per 24 h

subject.en: Action needed: check your Moodle connection
subject.ar: مطلوب إجراء: تحقّق من ربط Moodle

sample.en: The class list service is off for the Enara tool in Moodle.
sample.ar: خدمة قوائم الأسماء والأدوار متوقفة لأداة إنارة في Moodle.

sample.en: In the tool settings, set "IMS LTI Names and Role Provisioning" to use the service, then have a teacher open the activity once.
sample.ar: في إعدادات الأداة فعّل خدمة IMS LTI Names and Role Provisioning، ثم اطلب من معلم فتح النشاط مرة واحدة.
